head: 95894dd225ac00516015d16ea9933381242bb716

findings.cause: The older geometry check required the work panel to the right of the chat input.
findings.correction: Assert adjacent navigation/work/chat bounds once responsive motion has settled.

findings.cause: The CDP test returned DOM nodes by value when saving references for the round trip.
findings.correction: Keep the references in the browser and return a primitive to CDP.

findings.cause: Native chat content covered the center of the resize handle.
findings.correction: Isolate chat content stacking so the physical handle receives pointer input.

findings.cause: An unscoped submit selector also matched the chat composer in the approval dialog test.
findings.correction: Click the visible save action in the user editor.

findings.cause: An icon width rule wrapped the stage-add button one Korean character per line.
findings.correction: Let the stage-add button take its label width and align it at the end of the heading.

findings.cause: A reserved desktop chat column was still animating away after a narrow viewport resize, transiently leaving the center at zero width.
findings.correction: Release reserved space at the narrow breakpoint immediately and measure settled geometry in browser tests.

findings.cause: The Native rich-text editor consumed Escape before the chat overlay received it.
findings.correction: Handle the overlay Escape before the editor except during composition or a nested menu/dialog.

findings.cause: Selecting a new or existing conversation kept the history list open; the next history-button click closed it.
findings.correction: Close the history list when a conversation is chosen, without changing the work selection.

findings.cause: Several assertions still targeted the former work header, fixed widths, section order, or modal focus trap.
findings.correction: Verify the center toolbar and inline management surface, real content boundaries and steady viewport sizes.

findings.cause: Unmounting the ordinary Native modal emitted a stale close while switching into inline admin settings.
findings.correction: Keep the ordinary Native modal mounted with its own open state and render the active settings tab inline for admin. A close from the previous surface cannot cancel the incoming admin view.

findings.cause: With the left rail manually expanded on a narrow screen, the 224px editor could wrap stage names one character at a time.
findings.correction: For narrow work content, give the title its own row and move the count below it.

next_validation: Use the later product commit and PR #131 checks for the final result.
